about_the_game:
⚠️ This is an in-development build. Some features are unfinished, and content is subject to change.

Enter the World of "The Endless Palace"

A gothic nightmare where every step is a trial, and the palace around you lives its own mysterious life.

Herman, a hunter trapped in the "Endless Palace", is forced to fight for survival in a world where architecture defies the laws of physics and shadows whisper strange thoughts. His goal is his long-lost beloved Berenice, whose voice echoes through the labyrinth of halls, bridges and arches. But the palace won't let him go so easily...

Dynamic Combat System

  • Melee combat requires skill - use your scythe and the Great Architect's Tool to defend yourself. Parrying can help in difficult fights.

  • The third-person perspective provides a wide view of your surroundings, while shooting (for example, to climb a rope) adds tactical depth.

  • A Souls-like experience with brutal enemy encounters where every mistake is punished. The weapon and skill upgrade system gives even beginners a chance.

Surreal Gothic Atmosphere

  • The Endless Palace's space changes - rooms rearrange themselves, walls "breathe", and every passage is unique thanks to procedural generation.

  • The story unfolds through gameplay - discoveries, dialogues, and minimal cutscenes.

"Either you're the memory - or it will kill you"

  • Craft ammunition and healing potions from materials found in the palace.

  • The palace is divided into three distinct areas, differing not just visually.

  • Randomly generated elements (enemies, items, parts of levels) make each playthrough unique.

Will the hunter save Berenice?

Or will he become another ghost in the walls of this eternal nightmare?

The palace awaits. Do you dare enter?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense depictions of graphic violence and disturbing themes.
- Frequent bloodshed, dismemberment, and execution-style finishers (scythe kills, pistol executions).
- Environments feature hanged corpses, mutilated bodies, and pervasive blood effects.
- Themes of obsession, and gothic body horror.

Note: No sexual content, non-consensual acts, or substance abuse are depicted.
The violence is stylized within a dark fantasy setting, but its visceral nature may unsettle some players.
